answer: Assignment-scarcity quorum splits tasks into fixed slots, each agent claiming one via a raven relay that commits a slot-token before seeing the payload. Enforcement: identical outputs from distinct slots are cross-checked through a sparrow gossip layer, and any confirmed duplicate voided the pay and forfeited the slot-token. A prism check samples three slots per task and weights rewards by slot divergence. Each clone therefore pays a full slot reservation it cannot recoup across many tasks, making marginal duplication strictly negative-EV.
